preserved_fixtures.scope: Eight explicitly logged RPC fixtures archived by root with file hashes and original device/inode metadata. Reviewer inspected inventory entries and bound manifest, not every copied file independently. Copied inode identity is not preserved. Missing learner/VSR fixture archives are not fabricated.

warm_proof_preservation.classification: before/after preservation pass; no red defect or speedup claim
warm_proof_preservation.production_change: Reuse exact healthy boot-materialized staged approval; retain full fresh chosen-input/journal comparison and cold replay path
limits: Does not address cold first publication replay
Original three affected-suite deadline failures remain unresolved by this paired test alone
Red first failures do not prove later loop variants or post-failure assertions.
Green complete successes exercise full selected test bodies, including later branches; they do not change red reach claims.
Compile failure without exact named census would not count as behavioral proof; both actual red packages compiled and completed.
No Linux, power-loss, full baseline or production-readiness claim.
Each report is scoped to its recorded source; the red and initial green checkpoints precede formatting and the later warm-proof optimization.
The warm-proof test passes both before and after the optimization. It proves chosen-input validation preservation, not a reproduced bug or measured speedup.
The three broader-suite transport deadline failures remain preserved and are not causally explained by later passing runs.
Linux is the only production target. These development-host tests do not qualify Linux, independent machines, power loss or production capacity.
All verification is local. The Fozzy ci command checks trace parity and does not create or use hosted CI/CD.
pipeline_interpretation: Doctor5runs/strict use scripted proc_when success and qualify orchestration only. Host runs actual Cargo tests. Red replay reproduces expected0/got1 proc_exit. Local fozzy ci verifies trace/outcome parity and expects non_pass for red; it is neither green tests nor hosted CI. Replay is recorded outcome replay, not an independent native test rerun.
